contract: docs/plans/gallery-contact-visual-polish.md — compact photographic Gallery, Contact and shared interior/footer presentation.

accessibility.evidence: Album controls and footer contact links are at least 44px; form fields are at least 48px with 16px text. Explicit labels, consent and live feedback semantics remain. Enter/Escape photograph viewing and focus return were exercised; name-to-email Tab focus has a visible 3px outline. Empty form validation focuses the required name. Existing reduced-motion overrides remain unchanged; native preference and assistive-technology certification are not claimed.

responsive.evidence: 12 cases cover Gallery, Contact and the shared Partners form at four target widths. No document overflow or clipped visible headings/captions/labels. Eight Gallery/Contact text comparisons match the previous preview. Fourteen further route/viewport geometry spot checks pass. Tablet Contact label cascade and wide footer attribution alignment were corrected; final phone dialog is compact.

loading.evidence: Existing fixed photo aspect ratios and dialog bounds are preserved; loaded grid and enlarged photographs are captured. No new asynchronous loading behavior or hidden content was introduced.

empty.reason: No changed empty-state styling or collection logic. The Gallery empty branch and its existing emptyState rules remain unchanged; empty CMS collections were not injected in this presentation pass.

error.evidence: Keyboard activation of an empty form leaves the native required fields invalid and focuses the name; no sending feedback or enquiry occurs. Existing service error messages/alert and handling are unchanged. Delivery failures were not induced and this observation does not certify service error rendering.

partial.reason: No new partial-data path or changed fallback styling. All supplied albums are present; filtering shows a real four-photo album. Missing media/data was not injected and no claim of failure-fallback verification is made.

success.evidence: The populated Gallery retains all 20 photographs, filters to four and restores 20. The dialog opens and closes with focus restored. Contact content is unchanged; Partners retains its default topic. Live enquiry success is outside this visual-only verification and was not tested.

permission.reason: Public styling only; no account, upload, access change or permission request.

renderedEvidence.observation: Natural-case compact introduction, squared album selection, smaller album heading and framed photographs with complete captions.
Two-column Contact layout with corrected small method labels, 24px form heading and readable fields.
Single-column enquiry form, readable 16px controls and visible email keyboard focus; consent and action fit.
Shared Partnership form fits the narrow viewport, with full labels and no horizontal overflow; remaining controls continue vertically.
